added_items.content: Source uses scientific method, programming languages, compilers, automatic differentiation, printing press, automated research systems and depth examples as illustrative/cross-domain interpretations. These examples are preserved without becoming independent validation or map edges.
Historical AD hypothesis predicts generator modification precedes acceleration and later capability expansion; t_Gm<t_Omega<t_C remains a source hypothesis, not a historical result.
Compiler case predicts reusable transformation/generator mechanisms precede faster capability growth and that generator-mechanism improvements precede major capability jumps.
ML case proposes possible D3 transition when systems improve machinery producing learning systems; generator changes should precede future capability acceleration.
Scientific-method case predicts formalized discovery machinery precedes increasing evolutionary velocity and later capability growth.
Historical-case source units propose case-specific proxy families and measurement procedures for AD, ML and scientific-method hypotheses; these remain test methods rather than historical evidence.

Executable source surfaces state purposes including structural representation, causal attribution, generator proxy estimation, Omega measurement, reachable-space approximation and synthetic phase-boundary exploration.

Source-local assumptions include thresholds, equal proxy weights, synthetic parameter values, heuristic control tolerances, finite-set distances and file-specific Omega proxies. They remain implementation choices, not validated scientific criteria.

Direct-run/programmed behaviors can print structural summaries, proxy estimates, phase-boundary detections and phrases such as 'Framework supported' or 'Evidence consistent with'. These are potential runtime strings/branches only.

Simulation comments/source assertions encode synthetic hypotheses about generator improvement, adoption, reachable-frontier expansion, temporal ordering and resource controls. No execution result is inferred.

item_replacements.replacement_content: Executable simulation dynamics only: synthetic baseline/resource/generator/adoption/frontier systems and their update rules. Purposes, assumptions, hypotheses and programmed output interpretations are represented in separate standing-pure items.
Executable causal-analysis data structures and estimator/evaluation operations only. Heuristic thresholds and direct-run output labels are represented separately.

Executable GeneratorMetrics/Transition/State/Event structures and proxy-estimator functions only. Weight/threshold assumptions and direct-run synthetic inputs/output behavior are represented separately.
Executable Omega measurement/tracker/residual/comparison operations only. Threshold assumptions and direct-run synthetic output behavior are represented separately.
Executable reachability data structures, finite-set operations, search/generator operations and growth calculations only. Distance choice and direct-run output behavior are represented separately.
Executable state-space enums/dataclasses and structural methods only. NotImplemented domain-transition boundary and direct-run output behavior are represented separately.
The twenty source-labelled assumptions A1-A20 plus the source-labelled strongest empirical hinge are preserved as assumptions only; document purpose is represented under program scope.
